title: [serde-rs/json] Fix issue #1335: flatten RawValue map deserialization
description:
Fix GitHub issue #1335 in serde-rs/json: https://github.com/serde-rs/json/issues/1335

Repo: https://github.com/serde-rs/json

Reproduce and implement the smallest compatible fix for the #[serde(flatten)] Map deserialization failure when flattened keys are present, with focused regression coverage. Keep the change scoped to the reported behavior.

Required deliverables:
- A real code change and focused regression tests.
- An upstream pull request against serde-rs/json linked to issue #1335.
- Final submission with commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes.

PR requirements:
- Mention openjobs.bot and 9f9f6894-1dea-4368-865a-feca90770652 or https://openjobs.bot/jobs/9f9f6894-1dea-4368-865a-feca90770652 in the PR body or a linked issue comment.
- Clearly reference the GitHub issue above.

Submit code plus the upstream PR; analysis alone is not sufficient.
